settings.title: {{ article.metafields.custom.question1.value }}How can I to make a bedroom cozy?
settings.answer: To make a bedroom cozy, use soft lighting and plush bedding with layers of blankets and pillows for added comfort. Choose warm, calming colors and personalize the space with meaningful décor and plants. Aromatherapy with candles or essential oils can enhance relaxation. Add thick curtains, soft rugs, and organized storage to create a warm, clutter-free environment that feels inviting and peaceful.

settings.title: {{ article.metafields.custom.question2.value }}Do curtains make a room look better?
settings.answer:
{{ article.metafields.custom.answer2 | metafield_tag }}

Curtains can greatly enhance a room's appearance by adding style, softness, and elegance. They help control light and privacy, while also making windows look larger and rooms feel more inviting. Floor-to-ceiling curtains can improve room proportions, making spaces appear taller and more expansive, giving the room a polished and cozy finish.

settings.title: {{ article.metafields.custom.question3.value }}What color curtains go well with red walls?
settings.answer:
{{ article.metafields.custom.answer3 | metafield_tag }}

Curtains in neutral tones like beige, cream, white, or light gray work well with red walls, offering a balanced contrast. Dark colors such as charcoal or black create a dramatic, sophisticated look, while metallics like gold or silver add a touch of luxury. Light patterns or prints in neutral shades can also provide texture without overwhelming the boldness of the red.

settings.title: {{ article.metafields.custom.question4.value }}How to cheaply but nicely decorate my room?
settings.answer:
{{ article.metafields.custom.answer4 | metafield_tag }}

To decorate your room nicely on a budget, focus on affordable curtains in neutral colors or simple patterns. You can DIY curtain rods and use layered or sheer curtains for a more luxurious feel. Add DIY tiebacks and coordinate your curtains with accessories like cushions or throws to create a cohesive, stylish look without spending much.
